assumptions: All lane inputs are canonical unsigned field values.
Source bytes are mapped by recorded SHA-256 counter rejection sampling; modular reduction is prohibited.
Digest serialization is four-byte big-endian per canonical field lane.
Role, version, shape, and level occupy distinct lanes for fixed compression layouts.
The H7 application frame is part of the absorbed message and the published final-block-length domain remains in capacity lane 16.
limits: No benchmark result is a security claim.
No generic black-box ceiling is a proof for an instantiated permutation.
No independent cryptanalysis has been completed by this package.
